statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); dir_name=$(basename "$cwd"); git_branch=""; if git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git -C "$cwd" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ]; then if [ -n "$(git -C "$cwd" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ]; then git_status="*"; else git_status=""; fi; git_branch=" on  $branch$git_status"; fi; fi; printf " %s%s │ %s" "$dir_name" "$git_branch" "$model"
